release.lead: Example Booking Software today launched Waitlist Autofill, which offers a canceled appointment to the next client on a business's waitlist and books the first one who accepts. The feature, available now to salons, clinics, fitness studios and personal trainers in the U.S., the U.K. and Canada, fills slots that last-minute cancellations open up, without the owner calling around.
body_paragraphs: In a 90-day pilot across 48 businesses, Waitlist Autofill refilled 36% of 4,490 canceled appointments, or 1,617 slots. Salons saw the highest rate, at 44%, followed by clinics at 34%, fitness studios at 33% and personal trainers at 27%. The pilot included 18 salons, 12 clinics, 10 fitness studios and 8 personal trainers.

When a client cancels, Waitlist Autofill sends the open slot by text and email to clients on that day's waitlist, in the order they joined it. The first client to accept is booked, the others are told the slot is taken, and the business sees the change in its calendar. Owners choose how far ahead a slot can be offered and whether a deposit is required to accept it. Clients join a waitlist from the business's booking page when the time they want is full.

"A cancellation has always been a loss the owner quietly absorbs, even though someone on the waitlist would gladly have taken the slot. The owner just had no time to call around. We think the booking system should do that chasing, so the person running the business can stay with the client in the chair," said Maya Castillo, co-founder and CEO, Example Booking Software.

The launch follows a year of growth in online booking on the platform. More than 1 million appointments were booked through Example Booking Software pages in the 12 months to Sept. 30, 2026, 2.6 times as many as the year before.

"Saturdays were where cancellations hurt, because that's when we have a waiting list and nobody free to work the phone. Now the gap is usually filled before I've even seen the cancellation," said Jordan Lee, owner of Northside Hair Studio, one of the pilot businesses.

Waitlist Autofill is available from Nov. 10, 2026, on the Growth and Business plans at no extra cost. Businesses switch it on in their booking settings, and it works with the reminders, deposits and two-way calendar sync they already use. Clients don't need an app: offers arrive by text and email and are accepted with one tap.

release.full_text:
EMBARGOED UNTIL Nov. 10, 2026, 6 a.m. EST

Waitlist Autofill from Example Booking Software refills 36% of canceled slots in pilot

The feature offers a canceled slot to the waitlist by text and email and books the first client to accept; it is included in the Growth and Business plans.

NEW YORK (Nov. 10, 2026): Example Booking Software today launched Waitlist Autofill, which offers a canceled appointment to the next client on a business's waitlist and books the first one who accepts. The feature, available now to salons, clinics, fitness studios and personal trainers in the U.S., the U.K. and Canada, fills slots that last-minute cancellations open up, without the owner calling around.

In a 90-day pilot across 48 businesses, Waitlist Autofill refilled 36% of 4,490 canceled appointments, or 1,617 slots. Salons saw the highest rate, at 44%, followed by clinics at 34%, fitness studios at 33% and personal trainers at 27%. The pilot included 18 salons, 12 clinics, 10 fitness studios and 8 personal trainers.

When a client cancels, Waitlist Autofill sends the open slot by text and email to clients on that day's waitlist, in the order they joined it. The first client to accept is booked, the others are told the slot is taken, and the business sees the change in its calendar. Owners choose how far ahead a slot can be offered and whether a deposit is required to accept it. Clients join a waitlist from the business's booking page when the time they want is full.

"A cancellation has always been a loss the owner quietly absorbs, even though someone on the waitlist would gladly have taken the slot. The owner just had no time to call around. We think the booking system should do that chasing, so the person running the business can stay with the client in the chair," said Maya Castillo, co-founder and CEO, Example Booking Software.

The launch follows a year of growth in online booking on the platform. More than 1 million appointments were booked through Example Booking Software pages in the 12 months to Sept. 30, 2026, 2.6 times as many as the year before.

"Saturdays were where cancellations hurt, because that's when we have a waiting list and nobody free to work the phone. Now the gap is usually filled before I've even seen the cancellation," said Jordan Lee, owner of Northside Hair Studio, one of the pilot businesses.

Waitlist Autofill is available from Nov. 10, 2026, on the Growth and Business plans at no extra cost. Businesses switch it on in their booking settings, and it works with the reminders, deposits and two-way calendar sync they already use. Clients don't need an app: offers arrive by text and email and are accepted with one tap.

About Example Booking Software: Example Booking Software makes online booking, reminders and payments for salons, clinics, fitness studios and personal trainers. Founded in 2019 and based in New York, it serves more than 12,000 small service businesses in the U.S., the U.K. and Canada. Learn more at www.example.com.

Media contact: Dana Whitfield, Head of Communications, press@example.com, +1 555-0100

reactive_qa.q: Where does the 36% figure come from?
reactive_qa.a: The 90-day pilot sheet: 1,617 of 4,490 canceled appointments refilled across 48 businesses (18 salons, 12 clinics, 10 fitness studios, 8 personal trainers).

reactive_qa.q: How do you count 1 million bookings and the 2.6 times?
reactive_qa.a: Completed bookings recorded in analytics on Example Booking Software booking pages, Oct. 1, 2025 to Sept. 30, 2026: 1,014,928. The 12 months before (Oct. 1, 2024 to Sept. 30, 2025) had 388,280, which gives the 2.6 times.

reactive_qa.q: How do you know you have 12,000 customers?
reactive_qa.a: Active paying accounts in the billing system on Oct. 1, 2026.
Included in the Growth and Business plans at no extra cost. It is not on the Starter plan.

reactive_qa.q: Doesn't this just move the no-show problem to the waitlist client?
reactive_qa.a: Owners can require a deposit to accept an offered slot. [to confirm with Maya Castillo: pilot no-show rate on refilled slots]

reactive_qa.q: Other booking apps already have waitlists. What's new?
reactive_qa.a: [to confirm with Maya Castillo] Answer with what Autofill does differently; do not claim to be first.
